svg.title: How a removal ends the session
svg.desc: Remove account and Forget all accounts end the sessions at Autodarts before the extension forgets them. When a saved account plays on the page, the page signs out first; during a match the extension asks, and a no changes nothing. Then the extension ends every session that it keeps at Autodarts, all at once, with the sign-out that the Autodarts website sends, and forgets the accounts; Forget all accounts also deletes everything else that it keeps, with the key. When Autodarts answers, the popup says that the accounts are signed out. When it can't be reached, they are forgotten all the same, and the popup says that their sessions end only when they expire.
